method: tray: base 90 x 50 x 2.5 (each edge trimmed by the setback 5); four 90 deg bends R 2.5..5 along the trimmed edges (90, 50, 90, 50 long); four walls 2.5 thick, z 5..25, each running on past its bend by ext = (R+t) - (t + gap/sqrt2) = 0.732233047 at both ends; open corners. A = sum of prisms - 2 x joints
note: corner treatment is SolidCraft's convention (sheet.rs close_corners: panels extended until their inner corners are the rule gap = t apart; no corner fill, open corner relief below the walls)
